description: Land Title Settlement Department - Madugalla, Deraniyagala D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610565 (23/0882)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (Plot Nos. 1:35 to 1:47) in Mudagalla village, including details of extent, ownership status, and title classification. The content focuses on land property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
